findings.rationale: Accepted: qc_panel pin identity is engine+runner+endpoint, so the resolver's admission loop must carry the seat endpoint (QC_PANEL_ENDPOINTS, @none ≡ null) and the pin endpoint must equal it; negative isolated-store test added (§2.2, §2.6).

Accepted: unpin-seat selector frozen — --engine, --runner and --endpoint are required together for --role qc_panel; --endpoint @none means the null endpoint; never a wildcard; tests with null and named endpoints on the same engine+runner each remove exactly one row (§2.1, §2.6).

Accepted: the intake test uses separate spies for missionClaim and the generation claim, asserts both counts are zero, pre_spend_no_effect_receipt === null, and steps contains only the final_panel_seat_unqualified rejection (§2.6).

Accepted: index-negative and same-tuple-replacement assertions are relabelled preservation guards (green at base, recorded); change-pinning reds are exact-index admission, multi-row retention, selective unpin, endpoint-mismatch non-admission, and the pre-Mission rejection; mutants are supplementary only (§2.6).

Accepted: the intake check runs whenever qc_panel_seats is a non-empty array (no completeness gate); an incomplete panel still gets the existing validateReviewRoster defect later, but an unadmitted seat can never reach the claim adapter (§2.4); test added for the incomplete-panel case.
